name: ServiceRequestSourceFieldProjection
input: accepted validated Advanced Search field deltas for one exact surviving Service Request plus exact LLD-04 source_observation_field_id and source chronology/review precedence
transaction: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork after workbook parsing/staging/review completes outside the write lock
steps: resolve exact service_request_id from accepted SR identity/adoption decision
for each allowlisted active field independently classify accepted value as usable, explicit Current Handler clear, non-usable warning, unchanged usable, or reviewed correction/reversal

validate each accepted field through SrSourceEvidenceProvider and the cross-schema FK/guards so the LLD-04 published field belongs to advanced_search_sr, the same official SR identity and the same canonical field/value state
for unchanged usable field create no redundant field observation
for new/changed usable field or accepted explicit Current Handler clear insert append-only sr_source_field_observations row with exact source_observation_field_id
when chronology is comparable use precedence_basis=source_chronology; a changed value lacking comparable chronology cannot be assumed newer and requires reviewed_correction precedence
compare accepted precedence with the current pointer for that field and update only the applicable projection pointer

never clear a current pointer from missing/blank/malformed/unknown evidence except accepted Current Handler blank, which appends an explicit_clear observation and points current_handler_observation_id to it
insert bounded review/warning references through the owning reconciliation evidence model
increment projection revision only when at least one current pointer changes
commit accepted field deltas/projection pointers/receipt/audit atomically
field_independence: A newer row is not a whole-record replacement. Problem Summary, Report Date, Contact label, Severity, Handler, Status, Customer label/code, suspend facts and Last Update each select their own accepted current observation.
terminal_reversal: recognized terminal-to-nonterminal Status never follows ordinary pointer replacement; it enters a high-risk correction path bound to exact prior terminal evidence, and rejection leaves current terminal pointer unchanged.
reference_reconciliation: Customer Organization/Contact labels and Customer Account Code remain source evidence. LLD-02 candidate matching plus LLD-03 reviewed relationship services may establish reusable-reference associations; unresolved/ambiguous references do not block otherwise valid SR facts and never replace source observation history.
handler_rule: Current Handler source text/clear remains the sole current-assignment authority. A Contact relationship may resolve the exact current handler observation but becomes non-current for handler resolution when that source pointer changes; no local handler field exists.
rebuild: sr_current_source_projection can be rebuilt deterministically from append-only observations and accepted review/correction evidence; rebuild cannot create new domain history or audit events.
